purpose: Source registry for Hebrew Signal Fidelity evaluation. External datasets are adapters/controls, not direct Neta ground truth.

sources.name: Hebrew Paraphrase Dataset
sources.verified_repo_fact: 9785 Hebrew paraphrase instances; 300 manually validated gold instances; code-switching examples were filtered out.
limitations: Code-switching was removed, so it cannot test Hebrew-English mixed product speech.
Paraphrase equivalence does not itself establish Neta authority/action labels.
sources.recommended_adapter: Sample gold pairs only for first wave; add Neta-specific authority/action annotation without altering source labels.

sources.name: HebNLI
sources.verified_repo_fact: Hebrew NLI corpus based on translated MultiNLI; 302150 sentences; 884-pair manually verified gold set with entailment/neutral/contradiction labels.
limitations: Most data is machine-translated from English rather than native Israeli conversation.
Face-to-face and telephone genres were excluded because broken sentences and filler words were hard to translate.
Original NLI labels do not map directly to Neta decisions.
sources.recommended_adapter: Do not copy raw data into this repo until licensing is explicit; if used externally, prefer the gold set and score only inference-boundary behavior.

sources.name: Hebrew Question Answering Dataset (HeQ)
sources.verified_repo_fact: Modern Hebrew QA dataset containing 30147 questions.
limitations: QA is not natural product-feedback conversation.
Context resolution success does not prove pragmatic interpretation or authority calibration.
sources.recommended_adapter: Use context-dependent subsets as a control for premature reference resolution; add Neta-specific must-not-infer annotations.

sources.name: IronySet
sources.verified_repo_fact: NNLP-IL Hebrew Resources describes over 4000 cases of Hebrew newspaper words in quotation marks annotated by three pragmatics experts.
limitations: Newspaper quotation-mark irony is narrower than conversational Israeli irony.
Quoted text is only one irony cue.
License was not verified from the registry entry.
sources.recommended_adapter: Use only after license verification; treat as a pragmatics control, not direct product-language evidence.

sources.name: Corpus of Spoken Israeli Hebrew (CoSIH)
sources.verified_repo_fact: Spoken Israeli Hebrew corpus with recordings/transcriptions; prior source review indicated non-commercial/research restrictions.
limitations: Not suitable for silent automatic ingestion into a commercializable benchmark.
sources.recommended_adapter: Use only in a research-only evaluation lane after checking current terms. Do not redistribute raw transcripts here.

sources.name: MaTaCOp
sources.verified_repo_fact: Hebrew leader/follower task-oriented dialogue corpus; prior source review indicated access request and non-commercial/research limitations.
limitations: Task-oriented map dialogue is not product feedback.
sources.recommended_adapter: Use only as a research-only natural-dialogue control after access approval.

sources.name: Neta Synthetic Hebrew Signal Set
sources.verified_repo_fact: Purpose-built synthetic cases targeting Neta failure modes; no external copyrighted text copied.
limitations: Synthetic data cannot establish natural prevalence.
Must be supplemented with hidden human-authored holdout and external controls.
sources.recommended_adapter: Use for schema/gate development and TRAIN only.
